## Accepted full original lower-bound target

Problem 30002170 / OWR-12013-003, first substantive approach 1/5. The original lower-bound target is accepted after independent AI mathematical audit and acceptance review: for every fixed H in (1/4,1), every T>0 and every integer n>=1, the optimal conditional-expectation RMS error for the canonical iterated integral is at least c_H T^(2H) n^(1/2-2H), with c_H>0 depending only on H. Both independent standard fractional Brownian components are observed at every uniform sample time. The proof applies to every square-integrable observation-measurable estimator.

The rough range 1/4<H<1/2 is the substantive residual. The exact Brownian optimum and smooth-range asymptotic optimal rate remain credited known cases. No historical novelty/priority certificate, sharp constant, exact normalized-error limit, endpoint result, or adaptive/arbitrary-mesh extension is claimed.

## Complete proofs and mathematical audit

The edition preserves the complete localized Gaussian-witness proof, its all-H extension, the full Euler-to-polygonal canonical-convention proof, and the full independent mathematical audit. The audit retains all essential reasoning, including Fourier normalization, regularity and periodization, independence from both sampled components, signed-PSD-trace variance control, finite-identity/L2 passage, and joint-law transfer from the auxiliary Gaussian realization. Every displayed formula in these four mathematical documents is preserved byte for byte. No mandatory mathematical repair was needed.

Candidate/pending status is updated to scoped full-target acceptance. All material is AI-assisted and unrefereed; acceptance is not external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification. The explicitly identified established area-convergence theorem and standard Gaussian/Fourier foundations remain inputs.

## Attribution and publication boundary

The original problem is credited to [Neuenkirch's OWR contribution](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2012/41), pp.2524–2525. The convergence input is [Neuenkirch–Tindel–Unterberger](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.spa.2009.10.007), with the inspected [arXiv version](https://arxiv.org/abs/0902.0497) explicitly identified. The prior smooth-H result is credited to [Neuenkirch–Shalaiko](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jco.2015.09.008).

Exactly nine authored proof/audit/metadata files are added under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30002170/. No QUEUE or historical-accounting changes, source bodies/extracts/images, datasets, scripts/checkers, computational outputs/logs, private sources or coordination material are included. Optional finite-check and Brownian numerical-consistency paragraphs are omitted; no omitted computation is converted into prose. Public scholarly PDF identities and retrieval/inspection metadata, manuscript-version distinctions, and bounded-source/novelty limitations remain explicit. Edition preparation makes no new retrieval, PDF-rehash, source-inspection or literature-search claim.

Strict local clean-patch replay and native Git blob/tree identity checks passed. The complete expected tree chain preserves every unrelated entry. These local checks do not claim remote verification or CI success. Draft review publication only; no merge, release, DOI, or outside outreach.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
